name: @stxapp/stx-api-examples
description: JavaScript examples for the STX exchange API: signed REST and Phoenix channel WebSockets.
comment: The REST examples import nothing but node: builtins - Node has Ed25519 and fetch. These two dependencies exist only for the WebSocket examples: `phoenix` is the exchange's own channel client (join_ref bookkeeping, heartbeat, rejoin), and `ws` is the transport it needs under Node, because the built-in WebSocket cannot set the handshake headers the signature travels in. Versions are exact, and package-lock.json is committed: run `npm ci`.
